title: Return notFound, not forbidden, for policy-denied region entry
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Return notFound, not forbidden, for policy-denied region entry
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2132: "The server SHOULD also return `notFound` when the caller has no access to the region under its `accessPolicy` (for example, an `\"invite\"` region whose `invitedUserIds` does not list the caller, or a `\"space\"` region whose Space the caller is not a member of), so that the response does not reveal that the region exists."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:362-368
Now: When may_enter_region is false, enter_region returns forbidden("The caller may not enter this region.").
Change: Return not_found() there. Keep forbidden only for ban/eject cooldown and the different-user case. Update tests that assert forbidden for invite or space denial to the new oracle.
